verdict.rationale: Atlassian's feature page says the built-in Rovo AI can break big ideas into tasks and auto-assign them, create custom automations from prompts, surface trends, and connect related assets. That shows an in-product assistant performing some delegated work. All of it rests on one-line marketing claims, though, and nothing shows a user handing arbitrary tasks to an assistant that carries them out. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on what Rovo can execute when delegated a task, evidence of open-ended or agentic delegation beyond task breakdown and automation authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
